[USER] User inquired about the role of a music video in promoting a song or album.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided several roles of music videos in promoting a song or album:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Making the song more memorable: music videos enable fans to visualize what they’ve been listening to, reinforcing their love for the track.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Increased visibility: music videos help get a new artist, single, or album in front of audiences who might not come across it otherwise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Boosting sales and streaming: a music video released alongside a new song gives fans an additional reason to listen and engage with the new release.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Creating a story: music videos allow for the creation of a visual narrative that can increase the impact of the artist’s message.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Building a brand: music video concepts and aesthetics can help establish an artist's branding and image.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Social media engagement: music videos are tailored for social media platforms, which is perfect for promoting and sharing new music.  
[USER] User agreed that a good music video can enhance the overall experience of a song and make it more interesting to watch.  
[USER] User asked for favorite music videos that did a great job at promoting a song or an album.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided examples of successful music videos that helped promote a song or album:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Michael Jackson's "Thriller" - transformed the song into a worldwide phenomenon and boosted the album.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Beyoncé's "Single Ladies" - unique choreography made the song an instant hit and solidified Beyoncé's status as a major star.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. OK Go's "Here It Goes Again" - innovative, low-budget music video went viral and helped launch the band's career.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Lady Gaga's "Bad Romance" - visually stunning music video helped make the song a huge hit and cemented Lady Gaga's status as a pop icon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Taylor Swift's "Bad Blood" - star-studded music video conveyed a message of female empowerment and boosted the song's success.
